headline: US C-17s Deploy Air Defense as Iran Mounts Multi-Axis Air Defense
subheadline: Six US C-17A Globemaster III planes departed Texas carrying significant air defense equipment toward Middle East as Iran launched missiles and anti-aircraft fire.
lede: Six US C-17A Globemaster III cargo planes departed Texas for the Middle East carrying significant air defense equipment, while Iran showed heightened integrated air defense activity across multiple provinces. Iran reported missile launches, anti-aircraft fire, and drone interceptions, and Israel shared allegations with US and Gulf states about Iranian chemical weapons preparations. In Ukraine, Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of Shahed UAVs, Geran-5 missiles, and Bandero cruise missiles across at least ten Ukrainian oblasts, targeting energy infrastructure and population centers.

sections.title: Russian Barrage Targets Energy and Population
sections.body: Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of Shahed UAVs, Geran-5 missiles, and Bandero cruise missiles across at least ten Ukrainian oblasts. Critical hits included a Kharkiv hospital with 73 injured and over 200 patients evacuated, a Dnipro strike killing one and wounding 17, and a drone killing a 14-year-old girl in Kyiv region. A Geran-5 missile struck Kovel substation, targeting energy infrastructure, and Bandero cruise missiles launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv and Rivne.

sections.title: Iran Heightened Multi-Axis Air Defense Escalation
sections.body: Iranian air defenses were active across Kurdistan, Khuzestan, and Hormozgan provinces, including anti-aircraft fire in Sanandaj and Ahvaz, a missile launch from Bandar Kangan, and an IRGC drone shoot-down near Minab. Israel passed intelligence to US and Gulf states alleging Iranian chemical weapons preparations, while US officials reportedly remained skeptical. Israeli forces arrested six Palestinians from Jenin for rocket manufacturing and disrupted a Palestinian rocket-manufacturing cell in Jenin that conducted multiple launch tests.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran is demonstrating a heightened, multi-axis air defense posture with simultaneous anti-aircraft engagements and a missile launch, while Israel's chemical weapons intelligence was met with US and Gulf skepticism. The concealment of IRGC assets in Lorestan tunnels and runway denial measures at Doshan Tappeh suggest preparation for potential aerial conflict. Israel's disruption of an advancing indigenous rocket capability in Jenin and US air defense deployments signal competing escalation management.
